purpose: Teach: ロク/オンリー/゛/トロツキー/健太郎/二郎/ロビン/みずほ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、夜間勤務の終了時刻をロク、つまり六時に設定されますね
lines.en: So the night shift ends at six o'clock for the police station.
lines.style: Straightforward, matter-of-fact delivery. Neutral tone, steady pace. Confirming procedural detail with professional clarity. No inflection that suggests doubt.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地元オンリーの特殊事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: And the local police handle special cases within the jurisdiction as well.
lines.style: Continuing the same measured pace. Professional tone, slightly explanatory. The cadence of someone walking through routine operational points. Even, unhurried.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書の濁点、つまり゛の誤記にも注意されますね
lines.en: The written statements—you're careful about those voiced-sound marks, the dakuten marks, aren't you?
lines.style: Gentle shift toward the practical. Slightly more engaged—nodding to attention to detail. Still measured, but with a hint of respect for precision. Light emphasis on 'careful.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、過激思想、つまりトロツキー系思想の動向も把握されますね
lines.en: And you keep an eye on radical movements too—Trotskyist ideology, that sort of thing.
lines.style: Tone widens slightly. Still professional, but now acknowledging broader scope of work. Relaxed but observant. The ease of someone who understands the full picture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の新人健太郎くんの指導もされますね
lines.en: You're mentoring the new recruit, Kentaro, here at the station.
lines.style: Warmth edges in now. Tone becomes more personal—acknowledging human work within the procedural. Still calm, but with subtle respect for the responsibility. Slight upward inflection on his name.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人二郎氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: You're also taking statements from the witness, Jiro.
lines.style: Back to procedural, but grounded. Steady, methodical tone. The weight of witness testimony sits just beneath the surface—taken seriously, handled carefully. No rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、海外捜査機関ロビン氏との連絡もされますね
lines.en: And you're staying in contact with the overseas liaison, Robin.
lines.style: Professional ease. International coordination—the tone acknowledges complexity without stress. Clear, precise, collaborative undertone. Slight pause-weight on 'Robin,' recognizing the cross-border element.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害金返還にみずほ銀行口座を照会されますね
lines.en: You're looking into the victim's account at Mizuho Bank to arrange restitution.
lines.style: Tone settles into resolute focus. The gravity of victim restitution—stated with quiet determination. No hurry, but purposeful. The cadence of someone tying up the practical end of a case.
